Diagnosis.submission: The cart service was in CrashLoopBackOff, failing with "Wasn't able to connect to redis" / NOAUTH Authentication required. Root cause: the valkey-cart (Valkey/Redis) instance had authentication enabled at runtime (requirepass set on the live instance), so the cart service could not connect to its backing store. The valkey-cart deployment itself has no password configured (no args/env/configmap/secret), and a fresh pod from the same image allows PING without auth, confirming the credential was injected into the running valkey process at runtime rather than being part of the manifest. This caused cart to fail at startup and crashloop, making the cart service unavailable.
